implementation_notes: ES modules are the unit; each file's exports are its public surface and its imports are its coupling. Publish one barrel per module, keep helpers unexported, and avoid deep relative imports that skip the barrel (they create hidden edges).
idiom_name: ES module + single barrel index per module
pitfalls: Deep imports (`../../pricing/internal/calc`) that bypass the boundary
Circular imports between modules — a sign the cut is wrong
